milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the agent must navigate close to the blue carpet trail and look at it. Target is the center carpet block at (3,0,3) with max_distance=5 to require meaningful movement from spawn (spawn is ~4.2 blocks away diagonally) and facing_tolerance=60 to confirm the agent is looking toward the carpet.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the agent must navigate to the animal pen area and look at the llama. Target is the llama's position at (7,1,7) with max_distance=5 so the agent can satisfy this from just inside the fence gate or looking through the fence, and facing_tolerance=60 to ensure the agent is oriented toward the llama.

Uses inventory_has because shearing a sheep produces 1-3 white_wool items that go into the player's inventory. The player starts with no wool, and the only wool source in this scene is the white sheep (Color:0). If white_wool appears in inventory, the agent must have successfully sheared the sheep. This is more robust than position-based checks since it directly verifies the action outcome.
